title: FTB Industrial Colorations
description: Extends FTB Industrial Contraptions spray paint cans to all 16 Minecraft dye colors !
body:
**FTB Industrial Colorations** extends **FTB Industrial Contraptions** spray paint cans to all 14 Minecraft dye colors, plus the existing white and black

It recolors machine casings (white and light gray) while keeping original details: accents, indicators, solar panels, flames, borders, and other structural parts stay untouched.

Includes:

- 16 colors - white, black, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, pink, brown, gray, light gray
- Works with existing FTB Industrial Contraptions spray paint cans
- Colorable Quantum Armor !
- Spray Paint Kits and Spray Paint Selector to combine all Spray Paint Cans in one item

Required: **FTB Industrial Contraptions**
Mod idea by: **MrMLDEG**
